property_summary: For all callers and amounts, only the contract owner can successfully reduce totalSupply and their own balance via burn; the mutant removes onlyOwner allowing non-owners to reduce totalSupply (so for some caller/amount the mutant will decrease totalSupply while the reference never does).
change_summary: Change burn to allow anyone (remove onlyOwner) so callers other than owner can reduce their own balance, affecting balanceOf(k) for caller or others if they pass different address (but here burn uses msg.sender).
